snippet.title: Race Day | Trailer | Cities: Skylines
snippet.description:
Race Day will be available on the 10th of March!

The Race is starting!

Race Day puts you in control of your own motor racing circuit. Build a Race HQ, design custom tracks with new Race Roads, and schedule events that bring the roar to your city.

Available now: https://youtu.be/Z3iQxEmQCAU
